column1: # The rows scripts/sync.sh reads for a manual update (README.md, "Updating U-Boot"), tab-separated; comments and
#     follow branch:<name>   fast-forward to the upstream branch head
#     follow release:<tag>   fast-forward to the newest point release <tag>.<n> (or <tag> itself); the next
#                            release line is a new mirror row
#     mica/<board>-<function> carries that U-Boot variant's commits on top of the mirror (README.md, "Branches")
